question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to environmental?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical methodology to analyze and quantify environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their life cycle. It is used to evaluate the environmental performance of products and processes, and to identify opportunities for improvement. LCA helps in making informed decisions about product development and improvement, and in reducing the environmental footprint of products.
